responses.content: Based on recent M&A activity in the technology sector, valuations have shown a 15-20% premium compared to Q4 2023. Key drivers include strong revenue growth and market consolidation trends.
The healthcare sector has experienced significant consolidation, with an average deal size increase of 25% year-over-year. Strategic buyers are focusing on specialty pharma and med-tech assets.
Financial services M&A activity indicates a shift towards digital banking acquisitions. Cross-border deals represent 40% of total transaction volume, with Asia Pacific leading in deal count.
Energy sector transactions show increased focus on renewable assets, with clean energy deals accounting for 35% of total sector volume. Traditional oil & gas assets face valuation pressure.
